question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

Mrs. Meera and family / received his letter / a week ago.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence, "Mrs. Meera and family received his letter a week ago," is grammatically correct.
 
• All parts of the sentence are properly constructed and there is no grammatical error.
 
• Therefore, there is no correction needed in any part of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **No error**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Mrs. Meera and family received his letter a week ago."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Option 3: "Mrs. Meera and family" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "a week ago" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
